conversation.storage: thread (current implementation; subcollection migration is future P1)

userConsent.note: No consent is required for operational escalation; assigned upper ops may inspect and continue the ticket.

states.open: waiting for work or user follow-up
states.escalated: waiting in upper operations pool; assignedRole determines destination

notes: Claimed is represented by assignedTo rather than a separate status value.
A user reply to an escalated ticket remains escalated.
Broker application/verification state is unrelated to support ticket role authority.
